Synopsis:
Wyll's Romance scene in Act 3. Wyll invited the player to a romantic talk near the banks fo the chionthar.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_Wyll_CRD_Act3Romance_ROM.json: Wyll is a party companion (“the Blade”) with a fraught past — a devilish pact, a difficult relationship with his father, and recent confrontations tied to Mizora and the Ravengard/Lower City events. In Act 3 he asks the player to a private, romantic moment beside the Chionthar under the ancient Wilden Oak, offering a supposedly “wishing” acorn and a vow of lasting love. The scene follows from prior story beats (meeting Mizora, possible raids or arrests around Ravengard) that may already have affected Wyll emotionally, but here he asks to pause those troubles “for a toll of the bell.” Player responses in the samples range from hesitant to wholehearted acceptance or playful banter; the exchange culminates in Wyll kneeling and proposing a shared future.
- END_GameFinale_RomanceFates_Wyll.json: Path in epilogue when players have one last moment with their romance partner.Wyll could be1. The Blade of Frontiers2, The Blade of Avernus3. Grand DukeIn all three cases, he may or may not be pacted, and he may or may not look like a devil.
- Wyll_Recruitment_PostEA.json: Post EA dialog version.Initial dialogue with Wyll. In most cases, this will involve him training a tiefling child before the player breaks in, and you discover you were both on the mind flayer ship. Wyll comes across as a big-time hero, and wants help killing goblins. He is called the Blade of Frontiers by most.
- CAMP_GoblinHuntTieflingCelebration_CRD_Wyll.json: After the party, this companion is still trying to come down from all the energy, and with a good enough bond it is possible for the player avatar to flirt and unlock a romance option. For Wyll, you cannot romance if you have not learned about Mizora. He is enjoying himself, it would seem, and toasts you as you approach.
- WYR_MeetingMizora_OM_Wyll_COM_AOM_OOM.json: Dialog with mizora at Wyrm's Rock near the entrance to Lower city. She is in human form. Wyll sees his father taken away, and Mizora tells him to meet him in camp.

retrieved_synopses: Wyll is a party companion (“the Blade”) with a fraught past — a devilish pact, a difficult relationship with his father, and recent confrontations tied to Mizora and the Ravengard/Lower City events. In Act 3 he asks the player to a private, romantic moment beside the Chionthar under the ancient Wilden Oak, offering a supposedly “wishing” acorn and a vow of lasting love. The scene follows from prior story beats (meeting Mizora, possible raids or arrests around Ravengard) that may already have affected Wyll emotionally, but here he asks to pause those troubles “for a toll of the bell.” Player responses in the samples range from hesitant to wholehearted acceptance or playful banter; the exchange culminates in Wyll kneeling and proposing a shared future.

context: The scene is an Act 3 romance moment with Wyll — your companion known as “the Blade” who carries a fraught past (a devilish pact and a difficult relationship with his father) and has recently been emotionally affected by events tied to Mizora and the Ravengard/Lower City. He leads the player to the banks of the Chionthar beneath the ancient Wilden Oak, produces a supposedly “wishing” acorn, and asks for a brief respite from their troubles “for a toll of the bell.” Wyll speaks of time and forever, kneels, and offers a vow of lasting love while holding out the acorn; the player can respond with hesitation, playful banter, or wholehearted acceptance. This summary reflects the scene’s immediate setup and emotional context but does not enumerate every possible player choice or prior plot variation.
